title: Beyblade: Metal Saga
description: Beyblade Metal Fusion (Metal Saga – Season 1)Beyblade Metal Masters (Metal Saga – Season 2)Beyblade Metal Fury (Metal Saga – Season 3)A new cast of characters take on the continued battle between good and evil. Ginga, our hero, and his group of loyal friends take on a dangerous group called the Dark Nebula. Dark Nebula’s mission is to take over the world and unleash their evil upon it; but before they can do so, they must destroy Ginga as he is the only person that’s strong enough to stand in their way. The plot thickens as friends become enemies and enemies become allies. Everything starts and ends with Ginga as he struggles to find the strength to defend his world and the honor of Beyblade.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x1
episodes_data.description: Gingka saves Kenta and is challenged to an uneven battle.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x2
episodes_data.description: Madoka fights Kyoya with a broken bey Pegasus; Kyoya receives a strange visitor, who makes an enticing offer.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x3
episodes_data.description: Kenta challenges Gingka; Kyoya loses a battle and must leave with his opponent to train.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x4
episodes_data.description: Doji has a gift for Benkei, who later battles Gingka.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x5
episodes_data.description: Gingka is forced to battle a crab-obsessed villain who has kidnapped Madoka.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x6
episodes_data.description: Kenta poses as Gingka for a fight with Hikaru.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x7
episodes_data.description: Benkei mentors Kenta, who wants a rematch with Hikaru; Madoka helps Kenta develop a special move.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x8
episodes_data.description: Kyoya must prove himself during a challenge set up by Doji; Gingka thinks he's on a game show, but he's really being monitored by a computer.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x9
episodes_data.description: Kyoya battles Benkei; Gingka challenges Hikaru.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x10
episodes_data.description: Gingka battles Kyoya, who creates a tornado that rips through the city.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x11
episodes_data.description: Gingka hunts for Doji at the Dark Nebula headquarters.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x12
episodes_data.description: Merci sets traps for the gang inside the castle; Doji invites Gingka to join forces with him.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x13
episodes_data.description: Gingka battles an old nemesis who uses Gingka's anger to fuel a forbidden bey.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x14
episodes_data.description: Gingka's motivation for defeating Ryuga is revealed through a flashback focusing on his father.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x15
episodes_data.description: The gang go after Gingka, who has decided to go home. The journey is perilous, and the group encounter a strange traveler along the way.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x16
episodes_data.description: Hyoma leads the gang to Gingka, but Kyoya is suspicious of Hyoma's intentions.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x17
episodes_data.description: Gingka searches for a scroll that could mean more power for Pegasus.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x18
episodes_data.description: Gingka battles Hyoma---whom he's never been able to defeat---and uses his new power.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x19
episodes_data.description: Benkei and Kenta team up for a tournament after learning to swap parts of their beys, which increases their power.

episodes_data.title: Beyblade: Metal Saga 1x20
episodes_data.description: Gingka and friends enter the Survival Battle contest, in which the winner receives one wish. Meanwhile, Ryuga goes to a remote area and meets a powerful opponent.
